plain_english_policy: Modifying the ABM Treaty to allow deployment of a National Missile Defense System (NMD) was a contentious issue with mixed ideological implications. While some conservatives supported it as a strategic defense measure, others and many progressives opposed it on grounds of arms race escalation or treaty obligations.
evidence_quote: Do you support modifying the 1972 Anti-Ballistic Missile (ABM) Treaty in order to deploy the National Missile Defense System?
